item.title: Record Gas Prices on Election Day: Voters Face Crisis
item.description: On midterm Election Day, U.S. gas hits $4.12 per gallon and diesel $6.28, the highest ever, as the Strategic Petroleum Reserve drops to a 44‑year low.
